title:
This type represents an object that is trainable for machine learning purposes.

Parametrization:
DX - type for "x"/"input" data for training
DY - type for "y"/"label" data for supervised training
DEVELOPER NOTE: DX and DY should be immutable. This means the types should not mixin {@link Mutable}! In future versions,
this will be strictly enforced as a {@link MetadataIssue}.

Related Types:
